round2Failures.evidence: At 0282d514 `Tests` run 38492140618 is green (test, typecheck, lint) but `Legion Envoy and Contracts` run 38492140614 failed in job `dispatch` (https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs/38492140614/job/115620074034), step `Test dispatch dashboard` (`bun run test` in packages/dispatch): 2249 pass, 4 fail, all this issue's new AskCard.test.tsx cases — 'a full approval card names the earlier approval and diffs the two versions only when asked' and its compact variant fail at line 453 `expect(view.queryByTestId("version-diff")).toBeNull()`, receiving a `<pre data-testid="version-diff">` whose content is `# Decision / Use SQLite / Use Postgres`; 'the diff cuts every decision block, so answers alone leave nothing changed' (line 503) and 'the diff keeps a paragraph changed beside the decision blocks' (line 522) read that same leaked element's `del` (`Use SQLite`) as their diff. That content is `web/src/features/doc/VersionDiff.test.tsx`'s fixture (lines 6-16), a render that file never unmounts (it relies on testing-library's auto-cleanup), while the four new tests query `document.body` through `view.queryByTestId`/`view.findByTestId` instead of scoping to their own container as `ProofDocument.test.tsx:310` does (`within(view.container).getByTestId("version-diff")`). The tester could not reproduce the red locally on the same bun 1.3.14: `bun run test` in packages/dispatch passed 2253/2253 twice, once in CI's exact 154-file order up to AskCard.test.tsx, and a probe file saw an empty `document.body` after VersionDiff.test.tsx in three orders — so the leak is not deterministic by order, but the new tests fail whenever any `version-diff` is left in the shared document, which is the fragility to remove: scope the four tests' diff queries to `within(view.container)` (and unmount in VersionDiff.test.tsx), then push; a bare `gh run rerun --failed` would leave the fragility in place.
